Each element is a hash of the form `{user_id: integer}`, `{group_id: integer}`, `{member_role_id: integer}`, or `{access_level: integer}`. `user_id`, `group_id`, and `access_level` are Premium and Ultimate only. `member_role_id` is Ultimate only. Group protected branches accept only `access_level` and `member_role_id`. To change an existing element, include its `id`. To delete it, include its `id` and set `_destroy` to `true`. `member_role_id` [introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/241819) in GitLab 19.2.

after.description: Cursor for pagination. Use the `data.pageInfo.endCursor` value from a previous query to fetch the next page of results. Only forward pagination is supported.

glql_yaml.description: GLQL query that may include YAML configuration. Maximum size is 10,000 bytes. See [query formats](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/glql/#query-formats) for details. Pass a plain GLQL query, or YAML with the query in the `query` key and the configuration options as other top-level keys. The YAML configuration accepts these options: `fields`, a comma-separated list of GLQL fields to return, default `title`; `group`, the group to scope the query to, which cannot be used with `project`; `project`, the project to scope the query to, in the format `group/project`; `limit`, the maximum number of results from 1 to 100, default `100`; and `sort`, the sort order in the format `field direction`, such as `created desc`. A `group` or `project` set in the query takes precedence over the option.

admin_ai_catalog_item.description: Create, edit, and delete custom agents and flows in the AI catalog.

admin_ai_catalog_item_consumer.description: Enable, disable, and configure items from the AI catalog for a project.

admin_cicd_variables.description: Create, read, update, and delete CI/CD variables.

admin_compliance_framework.description: Create, read, update, and delete compliance frameworks. Users with this permission can also assign a compliance framework label to a project, and set the default framework of a group.

admin_group_member.description: Add or remove users in a group, and assign roles to users. When assigning a role, users with this custom permission must select a role that has the same or fewer permissions as the default role used as the base for their custom role.

admin_integrations.description: Create, read, update, and delete integrations with external applications.

admin_protected_branch.description: Create, read, update, and delete protected branches and branch rules for a project. Branch rules must target a branch name or pattern.

admin_protected_environments.description: Create, read, update, and delete protected environments

admin_push_rules.description: Configure push rules for repositories at the group or project level.

admin_runners.description: Create, view, edit, and delete group or project Runners. Includes configuring Runner settings.

admin_security_attributes.description: Manage the security categories and attributes. Also requires the `read_security_attribute` permission.

admin_terraform_state.description: Execute terraform commands, lock/unlock terraform state files, and remove file versions.

admin_vulnerability.description: Edit the status, linked issue, and severity of a vulnerability object. Also requires the `read_vulnerability` permission.

archive_subgroup.description: Ability to archive or unarchive a subgroup. This ability does not allow archiving top-level groups. Archiving unlinks projects from their fork networks and closes their open cross-fork merge requests, and unarchiving does not restore either.

base_access_level.description: Base access level for the custom role. Valid values are 5 (Minimal Access), 10 (Guest), 15 (Planner), 20 (Reporter), 25 (Security Manager), 30 (Developer), and 40 (Maintainer).

destroy_package.description: Delete packages and package files in the package registry.

manage_deploy_tokens.description: Manage deploy tokens at the group or project level.

manage_group_access_tokens.description: Create, read, update, and delete group access tokens. When creating a token, users with this custom permission must select a role for that token that has the same or fewer permissions as the default role used as the base for the custom role.

manage_merge_request_settings.description: Configure merge request settings at the group or project level. Group actions include managing merge checks and approval settings. Project actions include viewing branch rules, creating and deleting rules for all branches or all protected branches, and managing MR configurations, approval rules and settings, external status checks, squash options, and branch targets. In order to enable Suggested reviewers, the "Manage project access tokens" custom permission needs to be enabled.

manage_project_access_tokens.description: Create, read, update, and delete project access tokens. When creating a token, users with this custom permission must select a role for that token that has the same or fewer permissions as the default role used as the base for the custom role.

name.description: Name of the custom role. Defaults to `<base access level> - custom`, for example `Developer - custom`.

pull_container_image.description: Grants the ability to pull images from the container registry

push_container_image.description: Grants the ability to push images to the container registry

read_admin_cicd.description: Read CI/CD details for runners and jobs in the Admin Area.

read_admin_groups.description: Read group details in the Admin Area.

read_admin_monitoring.description: Read system information such as background migrations, health checks, and Gitaly in the Admin Area.

read_admin_projects.description: Read project details in the Admin Area.

read_admin_subscription.description: Read subscription details in the Admin area.

read_admin_users.description: Read the user list and user details in the Admin area.

read_agent_artifacts.description: Read GitLab Duo Agent Platform artifacts, including audit events and session metadata, that are exposed through the agent artifacts dashboard.

read_code.description: Allows read-only access to the source code in the user interface. Does not allow users to edit or download repository archives, clone or pull repositories, view source code in an IDE, or view merge requests for private projects. You can download individual files because read-only access inherently grants the ability to make a local copy of the file.

read_compliance_dashboard.description: Read compliance capabilities including adherence, violations, and frameworks for groups and projects.

read_dependency.description: Allows read-only access to the dependencies and licenses.

read_runners.description: Allows read-only access to group or project runners, including the runner fleet dashboard.

read_security_attribute.description: Allows read-only access to the security categories and attributes.

read_virtual_registry.description: Allows read access to virtual registries at the group level. Enables users to resolve packages through the virtual registry without requiring broader group membership permissions. Only works on top level groups.

read_vulnerability.description: Read vulnerability reports and security dashboards.

remove_group.description: Ability to delete or restore a subgroup. This ability does not allow deleting top-level groups. Review the retention period settings to prevent accidental deletion.

update_sec_ai_workflow_settings.description: Update security AI workflow settings such as SAST Vulnerability Resolution. Also requires the `read_vulnerability` permission.

allowed_to_merge.description: Array of users, groups, custom roles, or access levels allowed to merge protected branches. Each element is a hash of the form `{user_id: integer}`, `{group_id: integer}`, `{member_role_id: integer}`, or `{access_level: integer}`. `user_id`, `group_id`, and `access_level` are Premium and Ultimate only. `member_role_id` is Ultimate only. Group protected branches accept only `access_level` and `member_role_id`. To change an existing element, include its `id`. To delete it, include its `id` and set `_destroy` to `true`. `member_role_id` [introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/241819) in GitLab 19.2.

allowed_to_push.description: Array of users, groups, deploy keys, custom roles, or access levels allowed to push to protected branches. Each element is a hash of the form `{user_id: integer}`, `{group_id: integer}`, `{deploy_key_id: integer}`, `{member_role_id: integer}`, or `{access_level: integer}`. `user_id`, `group_id`, and `access_level` are Premium and Ultimate only. `member_role_id` is Ultimate only. Group protected branches accept only `access_level` and `member_role_id`. To change an existing element, include its `id`. To delete it, include its `id` and set `_destroy` to `true`. `deploy_key_id` [introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/166598) in GitLab 17.5. `member_role_id` [introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/241819) in GitLab 19.2.

allowed_to_unprotect.description: Array of users, groups, custom roles, or access levels allowed to unprotect protected branches. Each element is a hash of the form `{user_id: integer}`, `{group_id: integer}`, `{member_role_id: integer}`, or `{access_level: integer}`. `user_id`, `group_id`, and `access_level` are Premium and Ultimate only. `member_role_id` is Ultimate only. Group protected branches accept only `access_level` and `member_role_id`. Access level `0` (No access) is not available for this field. To change an existing element, include its `id`. To delete it, include its `id` and set `_destroy` to `true`. `member_role_id` [introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/241819) in GitLab 19.2.

deny_delete_tag.description: If `true`, denies deleting a tag. file_name_regex.description: Regular expression that committed filenames must not match, for example `(jar|exe)$`. default_branch_protection.description: Determine if developers can push to default branch. `0`: no protection. Users with the Developer or Maintainer role can push new commits, force push, and delete the branch. `1`: partial protection. Users with the Developer role can push commits to an empty repository. Users with the Maintainer role can push new commits and accept merge requests. admin_ai_catalog_item.description: Create, edit, and delete custom agents and flows in the AI catalog.

admin_ai_catalog_item_consumer.description: Enable, disable, and configure items from the AI catalog for a project.

admin_cicd_variables.description: Create, read, update, and delete CI/CD variables.

admin_compliance_framework.description: Create, read, update, and delete compliance frameworks. Users with this permission can also assign a compliance framework label to a project, and set the default framework of a group.

admin_group_member.description: Add or remove users in a group, and assign roles to users. When assigning a role, users with this custom permission must select a role that has the same or fewer permissions as the default role used as the base for their custom role.

admin_integrations.description: Create, read, update, and delete integrations with external applications.

admin_protected_branch.description: Create, read, update, and delete protected branches and branch rules for a project. Branch rules must target a branch name or pattern.

admin_protected_environments.description: Create, read, update, and delete protected environments

admin_push_rules.description: Configure push rules for repositories at the group or project level.

admin_runners.description: Create, view, edit, and delete group or project Runners. Includes configuring Runner settings.

admin_security_attributes.description: Manage the security categories and attributes. Also requires the `read_security_attribute` permission.

admin_terraform_state.description: Execute terraform commands, lock/unlock terraform state files, and remove file versions.

admin_vulnerability.description: Edit the status, linked issue, and severity of a vulnerability object. Also requires the `read_vulnerability` permission.

archive_subgroup.description: Ability to archive or unarchive a subgroup. This ability does not allow archiving top-level groups. Archiving unlinks projects from their fork networks and closes their open cross-fork merge requests, and unarchiving does not restore either.

base_access_level.description: Base access level for the custom role. Valid values are 5 (Minimal Access), 10 (Guest), 15 (Planner), 20 (Reporter), 25 (Security Manager), 30 (Developer), and 40 (Maintainer).

destroy_package.description: Delete packages and package files in the package registry.

manage_deploy_tokens.description: Manage deploy tokens at the group or project level.

manage_group_access_tokens.description: Create, read, update, and delete group access tokens. When creating a token, users with this custom permission must select a role for that token that has the same or fewer permissions as the default role used as the base for the custom role.

manage_merge_request_settings.description: Configure merge request settings at the group or project level. Group actions include managing merge checks and approval settings. Project actions include viewing branch rules, creating and deleting rules for all branches or all protected branches, and managing MR configurations, approval rules and settings, external status checks, squash options, and branch targets. In order to enable Suggested reviewers, the "Manage project access tokens" custom permission needs to be enabled.

manage_project_access_tokens.description: Create, read, update, and delete project access tokens. When creating a token, users with this custom permission must select a role for that token that has the same or fewer permissions as the default role used as the base for the custom role.

name.description: Name of the custom role. Defaults to `<base access level> - custom`, for example `Developer - custom`.

pull_container_image.description: Grants the ability to pull images from the container registry

push_container_image.description: Grants the ability to push images to the container registry

read_admin_cicd.description: Read CI/CD details for runners and jobs in the Admin Area.

read_admin_groups.description: Read group details in the Admin Area.

read_admin_monitoring.description: Read system information such as background migrations, health checks, and Gitaly in the Admin Area.

read_admin_projects.description: Read project details in the Admin Area.

read_admin_subscription.description: Read subscription details in the Admin area.

read_admin_users.description: Read the user list and user details in the Admin area.

read_agent_artifacts.description: Read GitLab Duo Agent Platform artifacts, including audit events and session metadata, that are exposed through the agent artifacts dashboard.

read_code.description: Allows read-only access to the source code in the user interface. Does not allow users to edit or download repository archives, clone or pull repositories, view source code in an IDE, or view merge requests for private projects. You can download individual files because read-only access inherently grants the ability to make a local copy of the file.

read_compliance_dashboard.description: Read compliance capabilities including adherence, violations, and frameworks for groups and projects.

read_dependency.description: Allows read-only access to the dependencies and licenses.

read_runners.description: Allows read-only access to group or project runners, including the runner fleet dashboard.

read_security_attribute.description: Allows read-only access to the security categories and attributes.

read_virtual_registry.description: Allows read access to virtual registries at the group level. Enables users to resolve packages through the virtual registry without requiring broader group membership permissions. Only works on top level groups.

read_vulnerability.description: Read vulnerability reports and security dashboards.

remove_group.description: Ability to delete or restore a subgroup. This ability does not allow deleting top-level groups. Review the retention period settings to prevent accidental deletion.

update_sec_ai_workflow_settings.description: Update security AI workflow settings such as SAST Vulnerability Resolution. Also requires the `read_vulnerability` permission.

approvals_before_merge.description: Number of approvals required before a merge request can be merged. Deprecated in GitLab 12.3. Create an approval rule instead. At least one of `approvals_before_merge`, `reset_approvals_on_push`, `selective_code_owner_removals`, `disable_overriding_approvers_per_merge_request`, `merge_requests_author_approval`, `merge_requests_disable_committers_approval`, `require_password_to_approve`, `require_reauthentication_to_approve` must be provided.

disable_overriding_approvers_per_merge_r.description: If `true`, prevents overrides of approvers in a merge request. At least one of `approvals_before_merge`, `reset_approvals_on_push`, `selective_code_owner_removals`, `disable_overriding_approvers_per_merge_request`, `merge_requests_author_approval`, `merge_requests_disable_committers_approval`, `require_password_to_approve`, `require_reauthentication_to_approve` must be provided.

merge_requests_author_approval.description: If `true`, authors can self-approve merge requests. At least one of `approvals_before_merge`, `reset_approvals_on_push`, `selective_code_owner_removals`, `disable_overriding_approvers_per_merge_request`, `merge_requests_author_approval`, `merge_requests_disable_committers_approval`, `require_password_to_approve`, `require_reauthentication_to_approve` must be provided.

merge_requests_disable_committers_approv.description: If `true`, users who commit on the merge request cannot approve it. At least one of `approvals_before_merge`, `reset_approvals_on_push`, `selective_code_owner_removals`, `disable_overriding_approvers_per_merge_request`, `merge_requests_author_approval`, `merge_requests_disable_committers_approval`, `require_password_to_approve`, `require_reauthentication_to_approve` must be provided.

require_password_to_approve.description: If `true`, requires approvers to authenticate with a password before approving. Deprecated in GitLab 16.9. Use `require_reauthentication_to_approve` instead. At least one of `approvals_before_merge`, `reset_approvals_on_push`, `selective_code_owner_removals`, `disable_overriding_approvers_per_merge_request`, `merge_requests_author_approval`, `merge_requests_disable_committers_approval`, `require_password_to_approve`, `require_reauthentication_to_approve` must be provided.

require_reauthentication_to_approve.description: If `true`, requires approvers to authenticate before approving. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/431346) in GitLab 17.1. At least one of `approvals_before_merge`, `reset_approvals_on_push`, `selective_code_owner_removals`, `disable_overriding_approvers_per_merge_request`, `merge_requests_author_approval`, `merge_requests_disable_committers_approval`, `require_password_to_approve`, `require_reauthentication_to_approve` must be provided.

reset_approvals_on_push.description: If `true`, resets approvals on push. At least one of `approvals_before_merge`, `reset_approvals_on_push`, `selective_code_owner_removals`, `disable_overriding_approvers_per_merge_request`, `merge_requests_author_approval`, `merge_requests_disable_committers_approval`, `require_password_to_approve`, `require_reauthentication_to_approve` must be provided.

selective_code_owner_removals.description: If `true`, resets approvals from Code Owners if their files change. To use this field, `reset_approvals_on_push` must be `false`. At least one of `approvals_before_merge`, `reset_approvals_on_push`, `selective_code_owner_removals`, `disable_overriding_approvers_per_merge_request`, `merge_requests_author_approval`, `merge_requests_disable_committers_approval`, `require_password_to_approve`, `require_reauthentication_to_approve` must be provided.

branch.description: Name of the branch to target for the package. Exactly one of `tag`, `branch` must be provided.

tag.description: Name of the tag to target for the package. Exactly one of `tag`, `branch` must be provided.

chart.description: The chart file to be published (generated by Multipart middleware)

minimum_access_level_for_delete.description: Minimum GitLab access level required to delete a package. If the value is `null`, the default minimum access level is `maintainer`. Must be provided when `minimum_access_level_for_push` is not set. Behind a feature flag named `packages_protected_packages_delete`. Disabled by default. At least one of `minimum_access_level_for_push`, `minimum_access_level_for_delete` must be provided.

minimum_access_level_for_push.description: Minimum GitLab access level required to push a package. If the value is `null`, the default minimum access level is `developer`. Must be provided when `minimum_access_level_for_delete` is not set. At least one of `minimum_access_level_for_push`, `minimum_access_level_for_delete` must be provided.

package_name_pattern.description: Package name protected by the protection rule, for example `@my-scope/my-package-*`. Wildcard character `*` is allowed.

package_type.description: Package type protected by the protection rule, for example `npm`.

author_email.description: Email address for the package author

content.description: The package file to be published (generated by Multipart middleware)

description_content_type.description: Type of content for the package description

requires_python.description: PyPI version required for the package

sha256_digest.description: SHA256 checksum of the package. Not required for uploads, but without it, `pip install` fails because package index URLs lack required checksums.

summary.example: A module for collecting votes from beagles.

file.description: The package file to be published (generated by Multipart middleware)

auto_ssl_enabled.description: If `true`, enables [automatic generation](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/pages/custom_domains_ssl_tls_certification/lets_encrypt_integration/) of SSL certificates issued by Let's Encrypt for custom domains.

certificate.description: Certificate in PEM format with intermediates following in most specific to least specific order.

user_provided_certificate.description: All or none of `user_provided_certificate`, `user_provided_key` must be provided.

user_provided_key.description: All or none of `user_provided_certificate`, `user_provided_key` must be provided.

inputs.description: Map of inputs, as key-value pairs, to use when creating the pipeline. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/519958) in GitLab 17.10. [Generally available](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/536548) in GitLab 18.1. Feature flag `ci_inputs_for_pipelines` removed.

ref.description: Branch or tag to run the pipeline on. For merge request pipelines, use the merge request pipelines endpoint.

variables.description: Array of variables to make available in the pipeline. Each variable is a hash with `key`, `value`, and `variable_type`. If `variable_type` is omitted, it defaults to `env_var`.

key.description: Key of the pipeline schedule variable. Must be 255 characters or fewer and contain only `A-Z`, `a-z`, `0-9`, and `_`.

variable_type.description: Type of the variable. Defaults to `env_var`.

active.description: If `true`, activates the pipeline schedule. If `false`, the pipeline schedule is initially deactivated.

cron_timezone.description: Time zone supported by `ActiveSupport::TimeZone`, for example `Pacific Time (US & Canada)`, or `TZInfo::Timezone`, for example `America/Los_Angeles`.

inputs.description: Array of inputs to pass to the pipeline schedule. Each input has a `name` and a `value`, which can be a string, array, number, or boolean. To delete an existing input, include the `name` field and set `destroy` to `true`. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/525504) in GitLab 17.11.

ref.description: Branch or tag name that triggers the pipeline. Accepts either short refs (`main`) or full refs (`refs/heads/main` or `refs/tags/main`). Short refs are automatically expanded to full refs, unless the value could match either a branch or a tag.

allow_force_push.description: If `true`, members who can push to this branch can also force push.

allowed_to_merge.description: Array of users, groups, custom roles, or access levels allowed to merge protected branches. Each element is a hash of the form `{user_id: integer}`, `{group_id: integer}`, `{member_role_id: integer}`, or `{access_level: integer}`. `user_id`, `group_id`, and `access_level` are Premium and Ultimate only. `member_role_id` is Ultimate only. Group protected branches accept only `access_level` and `member_role_id`. To change an existing element, include its `id`. To delete it, include its `id` and set `_destroy` to `true`. `member_role_id` [introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/241819) in GitLab 19.2.

allowed_to_push.description: Array of users, groups, deploy keys, custom roles, or access levels allowed to push to protected branches. Each element is a hash of the form `{user_id: integer}`, `{group_id: integer}`, `{deploy_key_id: integer}`, `{member_role_id: integer}`, or `{access_level: integer}`. `user_id`, `group_id`, and `access_level` are Premium and Ultimate only. `member_role_id` is Ultimate only. Group protected branches accept only `access_level` and `member_role_id`. To change an existing element, include its `id`. To delete it, include its `id` and set `_destroy` to `true`. `deploy_key_id` [introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/166598) in GitLab 17.5. `member_role_id` [introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/241819) in GitLab 19.2.

allowed_to_unprotect.description: Array of users, groups, custom roles, or access levels allowed to unprotect protected branches. Each element is a hash of the form `{user_id: integer}`, `{group_id: integer}`, `{member_role_id: integer}`, or `{access_level: integer}`. `user_id`, `group_id`, and `access_level` are Premium and Ultimate only. `member_role_id` is Ultimate only. Group protected branches accept only `access_level` and `member_role_id`. Access level `0` (No access) is not available for this field. To change an existing element, include its `id`. To delete it, include its `id` and set `_destroy` to `true`. `member_role_id` [introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/241819) in GitLab 19.2.

code_owner_approval_required.description: If `true`, prevents pushes to this branch if it matches an item in the `CODEOWNERS` file. Default is `false`. Premium and Ultimate only.

merge_access_level.description: Access level allowed to merge. Defaults to `40` (Maintainer role).

name.description: Name of the branch or wildcard.

push_access_level.description: Access level allowed to push. Defaults to `40` (Maintainer role).

unprotect_access_level.description: Access level allowed to unprotect. Defaults to `40` (Maintainer role). Does not support custom roles. Use `allowed_to_unprotect` with `member_role_id` instead.

approval_rules.description: Array of access levels allowed to approve deployments to the environment, with each entry specifying a user, group, or access level. Use `required_approvals` to set the number of approvals required from each entry.

shared_runners_minutes_limit.description: Maximum number of monthly compute minutes for this user. `nil` inherits the instance default, `0` means unlimited, and a value greater than `0` sets the limit. Can be set by administrators only. Premium and Ultimate only.

skip_confirmation.description: Flag indicating the account is confirmed. Default is `false`.

view_diffs_file_by_file.description: If `true`, the user sees only one file diff per page.

dotenv_variables.description: Maximum number of variables in a dotenv artifact. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/432529) in GitLab 17.1.

draft_notes_per_merge_request.description: Maximum number of draft notes one user can have on a merge request. Set to `0` for unlimited. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/work_items/636471) in GitLab 19.6.

integration_executions_datadog.description: Maximum number of Datadog integration executions that can be enqueued per minute, per top-level namespace. Set to `0` for unlimited.

maven_max_file_size.description: Maximum Maven package file size in bytes.

max_pipelines_per_merge_train.description: Maximum number of parallel pipelines per merge train. The default is `20` and the minimum is `1`. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/374188) in GitLab 19.0.

notification_limit.description: Maximum storage size for root namespace limit notifications, in MiB.

npm_max_file_size.description: Maximum npm package file size in bytes.

nuget_max_file_size.description: Maximum NuGet package file size in bytes.

organization_hooks.description: Maximum number of system hooks per organization, for hooks managed by organization administrators. Set to `0` for unlimited. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/work_items/632599) in GitLab 19.6.

pipeline_hierarchy_size.description: Maximum number of downstream pipelines in a pipeline's hierarchy tree. The default is `1000`. Higher values are not recommended.

plan_name.description: Name of the plan to update.

pypi_max_file_size.description: Maximum PyPI package file size in bytes.

service_desk_outbound_emails_per_day.description: Maximum number of outbound Service Desk emails per day, per top-level namespace. Set to `0` for unlimited. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/253087) in GitLab 19.4.

service_desk_outbound_emails_per_hour.description: Maximum number of outbound Service Desk emails per hour, per top-level namespace. Set to `0` for unlimited. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/253087) in GitLab 19.4.

storage_size_limit.description: Maximum storage size for the root namespace, in MiB.

swift_max_file_size.description: Maximum Swift package file size in bytes. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/12233) in GitLab 19.6.

terraform_module_max_file_size.description: Maximum Terraform module package file size in bytes.

web_hook_calls.description: Maximum number of times a webhook can be called per minute, per top-level namespace. Set to `0` for unlimited. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/571738) in GitLab 18.5.

web_hook_calls_low.description: Maximum number of times a webhook can be called per minute, per top-level namespace. Set to `0` for unlimited. GitLab.com only.

web_hook_calls_mid.description: Maximum number of times a webhook can be called per minute, per top-level namespace. Set to `0` for unlimited. GitLab.com only.

abuse_notification_email.description: If set, [abuse reports](https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/review_abuse_reports/) are sent to this address. Abuse reports are always available in the **Admin** area.

admin_mode.description: If `true`, requires administrators to re-authenticate before performing potentially dangerous administrative operations.

admin_notification_email.description: If set, [abuse reports](https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/review_abuse_reports/) are sent to this address. Abuse reports are always available in the **Admin** area. Deprecated. Use `abuse_notification_email` instead.

after_sign_out_path.description: Users are redirected to this page after they sign out.

ai_action_api_rate_limit.description: Maximum requests a user can make per 8 hours to aiAction endpoint

akismet_enabled.description: If `true`, helps prevent bots from creating issues. Requires `akismet_api_key`.

allow_account_deletion.description: If `true`, allows users to delete their accounts. Premium and Ultimate only.

allow_all_integrations.description: If `true`, allows all integrations on the instance. If `false`, only integrations in `allowed_integrations` are allowed. Ultimate only. [Added](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/500610) in GitLab 17.6.

allow_application_default_credentials_fo.description: If `true`, allows Google Cloud Application Default Credentials for offline transfer. Even when enabled, only administrators can use these credentials, and the bucket name must start with `gitlab-offline-transfer-`. Has no effect on GitLab.com. For more information, see [Allow application default credentials for offline transfer](https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/settings/import_and_export_settings/#allow-application-default-credentials-for-offline-transfer). [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/work_items/602489) in GitLab 19.3.

allow_bypass_placeholder_confirmation.description: If `true`, skips confirmation when administrators reassign placeholder users. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/534330) in GitLab 18.0.

allow_group_owners_to_manage_ldap.description: If `true`, allows group owners to manage LDAP. Premium and Ultimate only.

allow_local_requests_from_hooks_and_serv.description: If `true`, allows requests to the local network from webhooks and integrations. Deprecated. Use `allow_local_requests_from_web_hooks_and_services` instead.

allow_local_requests_from_system_hooks.description: If `true`, allows requests to the local network from system hooks.

allow_local_requests_from_web_hooks_and_.description: If `true`, allows requests to the local network from webhooks and integrations.

allow_project_creation_for_guest_and_bel.description: If `true`, users assigned up to the Guest role can create groups and personal projects. Defaults to `true`.

allow_runner_registration_token.description: If `true`, allows using a registration token to create a runner. Defaults to `true`.

allow_s3_compatible_storage_for_offline_.description: If `true`, allows S3-compatible object storage for offline transfer. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/work_items/579705) in GitLab 18.9.

allowed_integrations.description: When `allow_all_integrations` is `false`, only integrations in this list are allowed on the instance. Ultimate only. [Added](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/500610) in GitLab 17.6.

archive_builds_in_human_readable.description: Set the duration for which the jobs are considered as old and expired. After that time passes, the jobs are archived and no longer able to be retried. Make it empty to never expire jobs. It has to be no less than 1 day, for example: `15 days`, `1 month`, `2 years`.

asciidoc_max_includes.description: Maximum number of AsciiDoc include directives processed in any one document. Default: `32`. Maximum: `64`.

asset_proxy_allowlist.description: Assets that match these domains are not proxied. Wildcards allowed. Your GitLab installation URL is automatically allowlisted. GitLab restart is required to apply changes.

asset_proxy_secret_key.description: Shared secret with the asset proxy server

asset_proxy_url.description: URL of the asset proxy server

asset_proxy_whitelist.description: Assets that match these domains are not proxied. Wildcards allowed. Your GitLab installation URL is automatically allowlisted. GitLab restart is required to apply changes. Deprecated. Use `asset_proxy_allowlist` instead.

audit_events_api_limit.description: Maximum number of requests per minute per user to the instance audit events API.

authn_data_retention_cleanup_enabled.description: If `true`, runs cleanup workers that permanently delete authentication login history older than one year, and previously revoked OAuth access tokens and grants older than one month. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/work_items/579002) in GitLab 18.7.

authorized_keys_enabled.description: If `true`, GitLab uses the `authorized_keys` file to authenticate SSH keys, which supports Git over SSH without additional configuration. Disable only if you have configured your OpenSSH server to use `AuthorizedKeysCommand`. Defaults to `true`.

auto_accept_awarded_achievements.description: If `true`, newly awarded achievements are accepted automatically and appear on user profiles immediately. Does not affect achievements awarded before this setting is enabled. Recipients can still hide any achievement. Default value: `false`. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/work_items/607750) in GitLab 19.4.

auto_ban_user_on_excessive_projects_down.description: If `true`, automatically bans users from the application when they download more than the maximum number of unique projects in the time period specified by `max_number_of_repository_downloads` and `max_number_of_repository_downloads_within_time_period`. GitLab Self-Managed, Ultimate only.

auto_devops_domain.description: Specify a domain to use by default for every project's Auto Review Apps and Auto Deploy stages.

auto_devops_enabled.description: If `true`, enables Auto DevOps for projects by default. Auto DevOps automatically builds, tests, and deploys applications based on a predefined CI/CD configuration.

auto_duo_code_review_enabled.description: If `true`, enables automatic reviews by GitLab Duo on merge requests.

autocomplete_users_limit.description: Maximum number of authenticated requests per minute per user to the users autocomplete endpoint.

autocomplete_users_unauthenticated_limit.description: Maximum number of unauthenticated requests per minute per IP address to the users autocomplete endpoint.

automatic_purchased_storage_allocation.description: If `true`, permits automatic allocation of purchased storage in a namespace. Relevant only to EE distributions.

budget_cap_update_per_day_limit.description: Maximum number of `upsertUserBudgetCapOverrides` and `upsertFlatUserCap` GraphQL mutation calls per day per user. Default: `20000`. Set to `0` to disable the rate limit.

budget_cap_update_per_hour_limit.description: Maximum number of `upsertUserBudgetCapOverrides` and `upsertFlatUserCap` GraphQL mutation calls per hour per user. Default: `1000`. Set to `0` to disable the rate limit.

budget_cap_update_per_minute_limit.description: Maximum number of `upsertUserBudgetCapOverrides` and `upsertFlatUserCap` GraphQL mutation calls per minute per user. Default: `150`. Set to `0` to disable the rate limit.

built_in_project_templates_enabled.description: If `true`, enables built-in project templates when users create projects. Premium and Ultimate only. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/235284) in GitLab 19.0 [with a feature flag](https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/feature_flags/) named `use_built_in_project_templates_enabled`. [Generally available](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/work_items/593623) in GitLab 19.2. Feature flag `use_built_in_project_templates_enabled` removed.

bulk_import_concurrent_pipeline_batch_li.description: Maximum number of simultaneous direct transfer batch exports to process.

bulk_import_enabled.description: If `true`, enables migrating GitLab groups and projects by direct transfer.

bulk_import_max_download_file.description: Maximum download file size, in MB, when importing from source GitLab instances by direct transfer.

bulk_import_max_download_file_size.description: Maximum download file size when importing from source GitLab instances by direct transfer.

can_create_group.description: If `true`, users can create top-level groups. Defaults to `true`.

check_namespace_plan.description: If `true`, makes licensed EE features available to projects only if the project namespace's plan includes the feature or if the project is public. Premium and Ultimate only.

ci_delete_pipelines_in_seconds_limit_hum.description: Maximum value that is allowed for configuring pipeline retention. Defaults to `1 year`.

ci_job_live_trace_enabled.description: If `true`, turns on incremental logging for job logs. Archived job logs are incrementally uploaded to object storage, which must be configured.

ci_job_telemetry_sampling_rate.description: Sampling rate for CI job telemetry, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0.

ci_job_trace_update_interval.description: Job log update interval when the job log is not open, in seconds.

ci_job_trace_update_interval_when_being_.description: Job log update interval when the job log is open, in seconds.

ci_lint_api_require_authentication.description: If `true`, `GET /projects/:id/ci/lint` requires authentication, including for public projects.

ci_lint_limit_per_user.description: Maximum number of CI Lint requests per minute per user. Set to `0` for unlimited requests. Disabled by default.

ci_max_caches_per_job.description: Maximum number of caches that can be defined in a single CI/CD job.

ci_max_includes.description: [Maximum number of includes](https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/cicd/limits/#maximum-number-of-includes) per pipeline. Default is `150`.

ci_max_runner_managers_per_runner.description: Maximum number of runner managers for each runner. If a runner exceeds this limit, GitLab brings it back to the limit by deleting managers that have not contacted GitLab for at least two hours, starting with the most stale. Applies only when the `log_runner_manager_cap` or `enforce_runner_manager_cap` feature flag is enabled. Default: `100000`. To disable the limit, set to `0`.

ci_max_total_yaml_size_bytes.description: Maximum amount of memory, in bytes, that can be allocated for the pipeline configuration, with all included YAML configuration files.

ci_partitions_in_seconds_limit.description: Time window, in seconds, before new CI partitions are created and the system switches to the next set of partitions. Must be between 1 month and 6 months. Default is 1 month (`2592000`). Write-only. Not returned in GET responses. Deprecated. Use `ci_partitions_in_seconds_limit_human_readable` instead. Scheduled for removal in API v5.

ci_partitions_in_seconds_limit_human_rea.description: Time window before new CI partitions are created and the system switches to the next set of partitions. Must be between `1 month` and `6 months`. Defaults to `1 month`.

ci_runner_manager_cap_cleanup_backlog_li.description: Number of deleted runner manager records still waiting for background cleanup, above which the runner manager cap stops deleting. Default: `10000`.

ci_runner_manager_cap_deletions_per_run.description: Maximum number of runner managers deleted by each run of the runner manager cap. Default: `1000`.

ci_runner_manager_creation_ceiling.description: Number of runner managers for each runner at which the runner cannot create new runner managers. Existing runner managers continue to work. Applies only when the `log_runner_manager_cap` or `enforce_runner_manager_ceiling` feature flag is enabled. Default: `150000`. To disable the limit, set to `0`.

ci_stale_runner_managers_cleanup_backlog.description: Number of deleted runner manager records still waiting for background cleanup, above which the stale runner manager cleanup stops deleting. If higher than `ci_runner_manager_cap_cleanup_backlog_limit`, that value is used instead. Applies only when the `stale_runner_manager_cleanup_by_partition` feature flag is enabled. Default: `5000`.

ci_stale_runner_managers_cleanup_deletio.description: Maximum number of stale runner managers deleted by each run of the stale runner manager cleanup. Applies only when the `stale_runner_manager_cleanup_by_partition` feature flag is enabled. Default: `500`.

ci_telemetry_otel_endpoint.description: OTEL Collector endpoint URL for CI job telemetry.

code_dropdown_custom_clients.description: Custom "Open with" clients shown in the project Code dropdown list

http_url_template.description: URL template opened for the HTTPS clone URL. Must contain {url} exactly once

name.description: Name shown to users in the Code dropdown list

ssh_url_template.description: URL template opened for the SSH clone URL. Must contain {url} exactly once

code_suggestions_api_rate_limit.description: Maximum number of requests a user can make to the code suggestions endpoint per minute.

concurrent_bitbucket_import_jobs_limit.description: Maximum number of simultaneous import jobs for the Bitbucket Cloud importer. Default is `100`.

concurrent_bitbucket_server_import_jobs_.description: Maximum number of simultaneous import jobs for the Bitbucket Server importer. Default is `100`.

concurrent_github_import_jobs_limit.description: Maximum number of simultaneous import jobs for the GitHub importer. Default is `1000`.

concurrent_pull_request_import_jobs_limi.description: Maximum number of simultaneous pull request import jobs for the GitHub, Bitbucket Cloud, and Bitbucket Server importers. Default is `200`.

concurrent_relation_batch_export_limit.description: Maximum number of simultaneous batch export jobs to process.

container_registry_cleanup_tags_service_.description: Maximum number of tags that can be deleted in a single execution of [cleanup policies](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/packages/container_registry/reduce_container_registry_storage/#set-cleanup-limits-to-conserve-resources).

container_registry_delete_tags_service_t.description: Maximum time, in seconds, that the cleanup process can take to delete a batch of tags for [cleanup policies](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/packages/container_registry/reduce_container_registry_storage/#set-cleanup-limits-to-conserve-resources).

container_registry_expiration_policies_c.description: If `true`, enables caching during the execution of [cleanup policies](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/packages/container_registry/reduce_container_registry_storage/#set-cleanup-limits-to-conserve-resources).

container_registry_token_expire_delay.description: Duration, in minutes, that container registry authorization tokens remain valid.

credits_usage_per_day_limit.description: Maximum number of `creditsUsage` GraphQL requests per day per user. Default: `3000`. Set to `0` to disable the rate limit.

credits_usage_per_hour_limit.description: Maximum number of `creditsUsage` GraphQL requests per hour per user. Default: `300`. Set to `0` to disable the rate limit.

credits_usage_per_minute_limit.description: Maximum number of `creditsUsage` GraphQL requests per minute per user. Default: `60`. Set to `0` to disable the rate limit.

custom_http_clone_url_root.description: Set a custom Git clone URL for HTTP(S).

decompress_archive_file_timeout.description: Timeout for decompressing archived files, in seconds. Set to `0` to disable the timeout.

default_artifacts_expire_in.description: Set the default expiration time for each job's artifacts.

default_branch_name.description: [Set the initial branch name](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/project/repository/branches/default/#change-the-default-branch-name-for-new-projects-in-an-instance) for all projects in an instance.

default_branch_protection.description: Level of protection for the default branch. [Deprecated](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/408314) in GitLab 17.0. Use `default_branch_protection_defaults` instead.

default_branch_protection_defaults.description: Default branch protection settings. For available options, see [Options for `default_branch_protection_defaults`](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/groups/#options-for-default_branch_protection_defaults). [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/408314) in GitLab 17.0.

allow_force_push.description: If `true`, allows force push for all users with push access.

allowed_to_merge.description: Array of access levels allowed to merge into the default branch.

access_level.description: Access level allowed to merge into the default branch.

allowed_to_push.description: Array of access levels allowed to push to the default branch.

access_level.description: Access level allowed to push to the default branch.

developer_can_initial_push.description: If `true`, allows developers to make the initial push.

default_ci_config_path.description: Default CI/CD configuration file and path for new projects. If empty, new projects use `.gitlab-ci.yml`.

default_dark_syntax_highlighting_theme.description: Default dark mode syntax highlighting theme for users who are new or not signed in. See [IDs of available themes](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/blob/master/lib/gitlab/themes.rb#L16).

default_group_visibility.description: What visibility level new groups receive. Default is `private`. Cannot be set to any levels in `restricted_visibility_levels`.

default_preferred_language.description: Default preferred language for users who are not logged in.

default_project_creation.description: Default minimum role required to create projects. Can take: `0` _(No one)_, `1` _(Maintainers)_, `2` _(Developers)_, `3` _(Administrators)_, or `4` _(Owners)_.

default_project_deletion_protection.description: If `true`, enables default project deletion protection so only administrators can delete projects. GitLab Self-Managed, Premium and Ultimate only.

default_project_visibility.description: What visibility level new projects receive. Default is `private`. Cannot be set to any levels in `restricted_visibility_levels`.

default_projects_limit.description: Maximum number of personal projects per user. Default is `100000`.

default_remove_source_branch_after_merge.description: Enable the delete source branch option by default for new projects

default_snippet_visibility.description: What visibility level new snippets receive. Default is `private`.

default_syntax_highlighting_theme.description: Default syntax highlighting theme for users who are new or not signed in. See [IDs of available themes](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/blob/master/lib/gitlab/themes.rb#L16).

delete_inactive_projects.description: Enable dormant project deletion. Default is `false`.

delete_unconfirmed_users.description: If `true`, deletes users who have not confirmed their email after `unconfirmed_users_delete_after_days` days. Default is `false`. GitLab Self-Managed, Premium and Ultimate only.

deletion_adjourned_period.description: Number of days to wait before deleting a project or group that is marked for deletion. Value must be between `1` and `90`. Defaults to `30`.

dependency_management_settings.description: Dependency management settings. Set `security_update_scheduler_max_concurrency` (integer) to cap the number of security update scheduler jobs that run concurrently across the Sidekiq fleet. Default: `30`. Capped at `200`. Set to `0` to remove the concurrency limit. Ultimate only. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/239173) in GitLab 19.1.

security_update_scheduler_max_concurrenc.description: Maximum number of dependency management security update scheduler jobs to run concurrently across the Sidekiq fleet.

description_and_note_max_size.description: Maximum work item, merge request, and vulnerability description and comment content size in bytes.

diff_max_commits.description: Maximum number of [diff commits](https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/diff_limits/) per merge request.

diff_max_versions.description: Maximum number of [diff versions](https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/diff_limits/) per merge request.

disable_admin_oauth_scopes.description: Stop administrators from connecting to non-trusted OAuth applications.

disable_feed_token.description: Disable display of RSS/Atom and Calendar `feed_tokens`

disable_invite_members.description: If `true`, disables the invite members functionality for groups.

disable_overriding_approvers_per_merge_r.description: If `true`, prevents users from overriding approval rules in projects and merge requests.

disable_password_authentication_for_user.description: Disable password authentication in the web interface for users with an SSO identity. This does not affect Git operations over HTTP(S). Default is `false`.

disable_personal_access_tokens.description: If `true`, disables personal access tokens. GitLab Self-Managed, Premium and Ultimate only. There is no method available to enable a personal access token that's been disabled through the API. This is a [known issue](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/399233). For more information about available workarounds, see [Workaround](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/399233#workaround).

disabled_direct_code_suggestions.description: If `true`, disables direct connections for Code Suggestions for users.

discussions_resolve_limit.description: Maximum number of thread resolve and unresolve requests per minute for each user. Default: `0`, which disables the rate limit. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/work_items/606720) in GitLab 19.6.

domain_allowlist.description: Only users with email addresses that match these domains can sign up. Wildcards allowed. For example, `domain.com` or `*.domain.com`. If empty, all domains are allowed.

domain_denylist.description: Users with e-mail addresses that match these domain(s) will NOT be able to sign-up. Wildcards allowed. Enter multiple entries on separate lines. Ex: domain.com, *.domain.com

domain_denylist_enabled.description: If `true`, enables the domain denylist for sign-ups. Requires `domain_denylist`.

downstream_pipeline_trigger_limit_per_pr.description: [Maximum number of downstream pipelines](https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/cicd/limits/#limit-downstream-pipeline-trigger-rate) that can be triggered per minute for a given project, user, and commit. Default: `0` (no restriction).

draft_notes_create_limit.description: Maximum number of draft note create requests per minute for each user. Default: `0`, which disables the rate limit. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/work_items/636471) in GitLab 19.6.

dsa_key_restriction.description: Restrictions on the complexity of uploaded DSA keys. A value of -1 disables all DSA keys.

duo_code_review_decisions_enabled.description: If `true`, GitLab Duo can approve and request changes on merge requests.

duo_code_review_default_level.description: Default review level for GitLab Duo Code Review Flow. One of `lite` or `standard`. Beta.

duo_code_review_level_allowed.description: If `true`, allows Standard reviews by GitLab Duo Code Review Flow. Beta.

duo_custom_agents_enabled.description: If `true`, allows custom agents for this instance. Defaults to `true`. GitLab Self-Managed, Premium and Ultimate only. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/work_items/594615) in GitLab 19.0.

duo_custom_flows_enabled.description: If `true`, allows custom flows for this instance. Defaults to `true`. GitLab Self-Managed, Premium and Ultimate only. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/work_items/594615) in GitLab 19.0.

duo_external_agents_enabled.description: If `true`, allows external agents for this instance. Defaults to `true`. GitLab Self-Managed, Premium and Ultimate only. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/work_items/594615) in GitLab 19.0.

duo_features_enabled.description: If `true`, enables GitLab Duo features for this instance. GitLab Self-Managed, Premium and Ultimate only.

duo_namespace_access_rules.description: Access rules that control which namespaces can access Duo features.

through_namespace.description: Group whose members can access the listed features.

duo_remote_flows_enabled.description: If `true`, enables GitLab Duo remote flows for the instance.

duo_scheduled_automations_enabled.description: If `true`, allows GitLab Duo flows to run on a schedule for the instance. Defaults to `true`.

duo_template_project_id.description: ID of the project to use as the Duo Code Review custom instructions template for this instance.

duo_workflows_default_image_registry.description: Default container registry for Duo Agent Platform foundational flow images.

ecdsa_key_restriction.description: Restrictions on the complexity of uploaded ECDSA keys. A value of -1 disables all ECDSA keys.

ecdsa_sk_key_restriction.description: Restrictions on the complexity of uploaded ECDSA_SK keys. A value of -1 disables all ECDSA_SK keys.

ed25519_key_restriction.description: Restrictions on the complexity of uploaded ED25519 keys. A value of -1 disables all ED25519 keys.

ed25519_sk_key_restriction.description: Restrictions on the complexity of uploaded ED25519_SK keys. A value of -1 disables all ED25519_SK keys.

eks_access_key_id.description: Access key ID for the EKS integration IAM user.

eks_account_id.description: Amazon account ID for EKS integration.

eks_secret_access_key.description: Secret access key for the EKS integration IAM user.

elasticsearch_aws.description: If `true`, enables the use of AWS hosted Elasticsearch. Premium and Ultimate only.

elasticsearch_aws_access_key.description: AWS IAM access key. Premium and Ultimate only.

elasticsearch_aws_region.description: AWS region where the Elasticsearch domain is configured. Premium and Ultimate only.

elasticsearch_aws_secret_access_key.description: AWS IAM secret access key. Premium and Ultimate only.

elasticsearch_client_adapter.description: Faraday adapter used by the Elasticsearch Ruby Client. Defaults to `typhoeus`. Possible values are `typhoeus` and `net_http`. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/550805) in GitLab 18.5. Premium and Ultimate only.

elasticsearch_indexed_field_length_limit.description: Maximum size of text fields to index by Elasticsearch. A value of `0` means no limit. This does not apply to repository and wiki indexing. Premium and Ultimate only.

elasticsearch_indexed_file_size_limit_kb.description: Maximum size, in KB, of repository and wiki files that are indexed by Elasticsearch. Premium and Ultimate only.

elasticsearch_indexing.description: If `true`, turns on indexing for advanced search. Premium and Ultimate only.

elasticsearch_limit_indexing.description: If `true`, limits Elasticsearch to index certain namespaces and projects. Premium and Ultimate only.

elasticsearch_max_bulk_concurrency.description: Maximum concurrency of Elasticsearch bulk requests per indexing operation. This only applies to repository indexing operations. Premium and Ultimate only.

elasticsearch_max_bulk_size_mb.description: Maximum size of Elasticsearch bulk indexing requests in MB. This only applies to repository indexing operations. Premium and Ultimate only.

elasticsearch_max_code_indexing_concurre.description: Maximum concurrency of Elasticsearch code indexing background jobs. This only applies to repository indexing operations. Premium and Ultimate only.

elasticsearch_namespace_ids.description: IDs of namespaces to index with Elasticsearch if `elasticsearch_limit_indexing` is enabled. Premium and Ultimate only.

elasticsearch_password.description: Password of your Elasticsearch instance. Premium and Ultimate only.

elasticsearch_pause_indexing.description: If `true`, pauses Elasticsearch indexing for both Advanced Search and ActiveContext.

elasticsearch_project_ids.description: IDs of projects to index with Elasticsearch if `elasticsearch_limit_indexing` is enabled. Premium and Ultimate only.

elasticsearch_replicas.description: Number of replicas for Elasticsearch indices. Use an integer to set all indices to the same value. Use an object to set per-index values. For example: `{"gitlab-production": 1, "gitlab-production-notes": 2}`. When using an object, you must provide both `elasticsearch_shards` and `elasticsearch_replicas` for each index. If either value is missing for an index, that index is skipped. Premium and Ultimate only.

elasticsearch_requeue_workers.description: If `true`, enables automatic requeuing of indexing workers. This improves non-code indexing throughput by enqueuing Sidekiq jobs until all documents are processed. Premium and Ultimate only.

elasticsearch_retry_on_failure.description: Maximum number of possible retries for Elasticsearch search requests. Premium and Ultimate only.

elasticsearch_search.description: If `true`, enables Elasticsearch search. Premium and Ultimate only.

elasticsearch_shards.description: Number of shards for Elasticsearch indices. Use an integer to set all indices to the same value. Use an object to set per-index values. For example: `{"gitlab-production": 5, "gitlab-production-notes": 3}`. When using an object, you must provide both `elasticsearch_shards` and `elasticsearch_replicas` for each index. If either value is missing for an index, that index is skipped. Premium and Ultimate only.

elasticsearch_url.description: URL to use for connecting to Elasticsearch. Use a comma-separated list or an array to support clustering (for example, `http://localhost:9200, http://localhost:9201` or `["http://localhost:9200", "http://localhost:9201"]`). Premium and Ultimate only.

elasticsearch_username.description: Username of your Elasticsearch instance. Premium and Ultimate only.

elasticsearch_worker_number_of_shards.description: Number of indexing worker shards. This improves non-code indexing throughput by enqueuing more parallel Sidekiq jobs. Default is `2`. Premium and Ultimate only.

email_additional_text.description: Additional text added to the bottom of every email for legal/auditing/compliance reasons. Premium and Ultimate only.

email_author_in_body.description: If `true`, includes the name of the issue, merge request, or comment author in the email body. Useful when email servers do not support overriding the sender name.

email_confirmation_setting.description: Specifies whether users must confirm their email address before signing in. `off` does not require confirmation, `soft` allows sign-in during a confirmation period, and `hard` requires confirmation before sign-in.

email_otp_enabled.description: If `true`, enables email-based one-time passwords (OTP) as a multi-factor authentication method. Requires `require_email_verification_on_account_locked` to be `true`.

email_restrictions.description: Regular expression that is checked against the email used during registration.

email_restrictions_enabled.description: If `true`, prevents new users from signing up with an email address that matches the `email_restrictions` regular expression.

enable_artifact_external_redirect_warnin.description: If `true`, shows the external redirect page that warns about user-generated content in GitLab Pages.

enabled_git_access_protocol.description: Protocol allowed for Git access. Set to `all` to allow both SSH and HTTP(S).

enforce_pipl_compliance.description: If `true`, enforces PIPL compliance on GitLab.com.

enforce_terms.description: If `true`, enforces the application terms of service for all users. Requires `terms`.

environment_delete_rows_limit_per_user.description: Maximum number of deployment, job, and merge request link rows each user can delete with environments every minute.

external_auth_client_cert.description: Certificate to use to authenticate with the external authorization service. Requires `external_auth_client_key`.

external_auth_client_key.description: Private key for the certificate when authentication is required for the external authorization service. Encrypted when stored.

external_auth_client_key_pass.description: Passphrase to use for the private key when authenticating with the external authorization service. Encrypted when stored.

external_authorization_service_default_l.description: Default classification label to use when requesting authorization and no classification label has been specified on the project.

external_authorization_service_enabled.description: If `true`, uses an external authorization service for accessing projects. Requires `external_authorization_service_default_label`, `external_authorization_service_timeout`, and `external_authorization_service_url`.

external_authorization_service_timeout.description: The timeout after which an authorization request is aborted, in seconds. When a request times out, access is denied to the user. (min: 0.001, max: 10, step: 0.001).

external_authorization_service_url.description: URL to which authorization requests are directed.

external_pipeline_validation_service_tim.description: Time to wait for a response from the pipeline validation service, in seconds. Assumes `OK` if it times out.

external_pipeline_validation_service_tok.description: Token to include as the `X-Gitlab-Token` header in requests to the URL in `external_pipeline_validation_service_url`.

external_pipeline_validation_service_url.description: URL to use for pipeline validation requests.

failed_login_attempts_unlock_period_in_m.description: Time period in minutes after which the user is unlocked when maximum number of failed sign-in attempts reached.

feature_flag_user_list_write_bytes_limit.description: Maximum number of bytes of feature flag user lists a user can write per minute.

file_template_project_id.description: ID of the project to load custom file templates from. Premium and Ultimate only.

first_day_of_week.description: Start day of the week for calendar views and date pickers. Valid values are `0` (default) for Sunday, `1` for Monday, and `6` for Saturday.

floc_enabled.description: If `true`, enables FloC (Federated Learning of Cohorts).

geo_node_allowed_ips.description: Comma-separated list of IPs and CIDRs of allowed secondary nodes. For example, `1.1.1.1, 2.2.2.0/24`. GitLab Self-Managed, Premium and Ultimate only.

geo_status_timeout.description: Number of seconds after which a request to get a secondary node status times out. GitLab Self-Managed, Premium and Ultimate only.

git_push_per_project_limit.description: Maximum number of Git pushes every minute to one project, over HTTPS and SSH. Default: `600`. Set to `0` to disable the limit. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/269867) in GitLab 19.6. This attribute is in beta and might be changed or removed without notice.

git_push_pipeline_limit.description: Maximum number of branch or tag pipelines that can be triggered by a single Git push. Set to `0` to disable the limit.

git_rate_limit_users_alertlist.description: List of user IDs that are emailed when the Git abuse rate limit is exceeded. Default: `[]`, Maximum: 100 user IDs. GitLab Self-Managed, Ultimate only.

git_rate_limit_users_allowlist.description: List of usernames excluded from Git anti-abuse rate limits. Default: `[]`, Maximum: 100 usernames. GitLab Self-Managed, Ultimate only.

git_two_factor_session_expiry.description: Maximum duration (in minutes) of a session for Git operations when 2FA is enabled. Premium and Ultimate only.

gitaly_timeout_default.description: Default Gitaly timeout, in seconds. Set to `0` to disable timeouts.

gitaly_timeout_fast.description: Gitaly fast operation timeout, in seconds. Set to 0 to disable timeouts.

gitaly_timeout_medium.description: Medium Gitaly timeout, in seconds. Set to 0 to disable timeouts.

github_gists_import_limit.description: Maximum number of GitHub gists import requests per minute, per user. Default: `6`. Set to `0` to disable the rate limit.

gitlab_dedicated_instance.description: If `true`, the instance was provisioned for GitLab Dedicated.

gitlab_environment_toolkit_instance.description: If `true`, the instance was provisioned with the GitLab Environment Toolkit for Service Ping reporting.

gitlab_product_usage_data_enabled.description: If `true`, product usage data collection is enabled. When the `GITLAB_PRODUCT_USAGE_DATA_ENABLED` environment variable is set, the API returns the effective value from the environment variable.

gitlab_shell_operation_limit.description: Maximum number of Git operations per minute a user can perform. Default: `600`.

gitlab_shell_operation_per_actor_limit.description: Maximum number of Git operations one user or deploy key can perform every minute across all repositories. Default: `6000`. Set to `0` to disable the limit. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/267274) in GitLab 19.6. This attribute is in beta and might be changed or removed without notice.

gitpod_url.description: Ona instance URL for the integration.

globally_allowed_ips.description: Comma-separated list of IP addresses and CIDRs always allowed for inbound traffic. For example, `1.1.1.1, 2.2.2.0/24`.

group_audit_events_api_limit.description: Maximum number of requests per minute per user per group to the group audit events API.

group_hooks_create_limit.description: Maximum number of group webhooks a user can create per minute for a given group. Default: `10`. Set to `0` to disable limits. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/635281) in GitLab 19.6.

group_owners_can_manage_default_branch_p.description: If `true`, allows group owners to manage default branch protection in their groups. If `false`, group owners cannot override the instance default branch protection. GitLab Self-Managed, Premium and Ultimate only.

group_relations_export_download_limit.description: Maximum number of group relations export downloads per minute per user for each group during direct transfer migrations. Set to `0` to disable the rate limit.

group_relations_export_limit.description: Maximum number of group relations export requests per minute per user for each group during direct transfer migrations. Set to `0` to disable the rate limit.

group_runner_token_expiration_interval.description: Set the expiration time (in seconds) of authentication tokens of newly registered group runners. Minimum value is 7200 seconds. For more information, see [Automatically rotate authentication tokens](https://docs.gitlab.com/ci/runners/configure_runners/#automatically-rotate-runner-authentication-tokens).

group_secrets_limit.description: Maximum number of secrets allowed per group in Secrets Manager. Default: 500. To disable the limit, set to `0`. Ultimate only. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/219436) in GitLab 18.9.

hand_raise_lead_create_limit.description: Maximum number of hand-raise lead requests per hour per user. Default: `10`. Set to `0` to disable the rate limit.

hashed_storage_enabled.description: Create new projects using hashed storage paths: Enable immutable, hash-based paths and repository names to store repositories on disk. This prevents repositories from having to be moved or renamed when the Project URL changes and may improve disk I/O performance. (Always enabled in GitLab versions 13.0 and later, configuration is scheduled for removal in 14.0)

help_page_hide_commercial_content.description: If `true`, hides marketing-related entries from help.

help_page_support_url.description: Alternate support URL for help page and help dropdown.

help_page_text.description: Custom text displayed on the help page.

hide_third_party_offers.description: If `true`, hides offers from third parties in GitLab.

home_page_url.description: Users who are not signed in are redirected to this page.

housekeeping_enabled.description: Enable automatic repository housekeeping (git repack, git gc)

housekeeping_full_repack_period.description: Number of Git pushes after which a full `git repack` is run. Deprecated. Use `housekeeping_optimize_repository_period` instead. All or none of `housekeeping_full_repack_period`, `housekeeping_gc_period`, `housekeeping_incremental_repack_period` must be provided.

housekeeping_gc_period.description: Number of Git pushes after which `git gc` is run. Deprecated. Use `housekeeping_optimize_repository_period` instead. All or none of `housekeeping_full_repack_period`, `housekeeping_gc_period`, `housekeeping_incremental_repack_period` must be provided.

housekeeping_incremental_repack_period.description: Number of Git pushes after which an incremental `git repack` is run. Deprecated. Use `housekeeping_optimize_repository_period` instead. Exactly one of `housekeeping_incremental_repack_period`, `housekeeping_optimize_repository_period` must be provided. All or none of `housekeeping_full_repack_period`, `housekeeping_gc_period`, `housekeeping_incremental_repack_period` must be provided.

housekeeping_optimize_repository_period.description: Number of Git pushes after which Gitaly is asked to optimize a repository. Exactly one of `housekeeping_incremental_repack_period`, `housekeeping_optimize_repository_period` must be provided.

html_emails_enabled.description: If `true`, sends emails in both HTML and plain text formats. If `false`, sends emails in plain text only. Defaults to `true`.

iframe_rendering_allowlist.description: IDs of embed providers users can embed content from. Enter multiple entries separated by commas or on separate lines.

iframe_rendering_allowlist_raw.description: Raw newline- or comma-separated list of IDs of embed providers users can embed content from.

iframe_rendering_enabled.description: If `true`, allows rendering of iframes in Markdown.

import_sources.description: Sources to allow project import from. OmniAuth must be configured for GitHub, Bitbucket, and GitLab.com.

inactive_projects_delete_after_months.description: If `delete_inactive_projects` is `true`, the time (in months) to wait before deleting dormant projects. Default is `2`.

inactive_projects_min_size_mb.description: If `delete_inactive_projects` is `true`, the minimum repository size, in MB, for projects to be checked for inactivity. Default is `0`.

inactive_projects_send_warning_email_aft.description: If `delete_inactive_projects` is `true`, sets the time (in months) to wait before emailing Maintainers that the project is scheduled to be deleted because it is dormant. Default is `1`.

inactive_resource_access_tokens_delete_a.description: Specifies retention period for inactive project and group access tokens. Default is `30`.

include_optional_metrics_in_service_ping.description: If `true`, enables optional metrics in Service Ping.

insights_query_limit.description: Maximum number of Insights chart queries per minute for each user or IP address, for each group or project. Default: `0`, which disables the rate limit. GitLab.com uses `60`.

invisible_captcha_enabled.description: If `true`, enables Invisible CAPTCHA spam detection during account creation.

issues_analytics_limit.description: Maximum number of issue analytics chart requests a user can make every minute in a group or project. For unauthenticated requests, the limit applies to each IP address. Default: `60`. Set to `0` to disable the rate limit.

issues_create_limit.description: Maximum number of issue creation requests allowed per minute per user. Set to 0 for unlimited requests per minute.

jira_connect_application_key.description: ID of the OAuth application used to authenticate with the GitLab for Jira Cloud app.

jira_connect_domain_allowlist.description: List of Jira domains that can install the GitLab for Jira Cloud app. Applies to the Connect app only. If empty, all domains are allowed.

jira_connect_domain_allowlist_raw.description: Raw newline- or comma-separated list of Jira domains that can install the GitLab for Jira Cloud app. Applies to the Connect app only.

jira_connect_proxy_url.description: URL of the GitLab instance used as a proxy for the GitLab for Jira Cloud app.

jira_connect_public_key_storage_enabled.description: If `true`, enables public key storage for the GitLab for Jira Cloud app.

jira_forge_app_id.description: Atlassian Forge app ID (ARI) of the GitLab for Jira Cloud app, used to verify inbound Forge Invocation Tokens.

job_cancel_limit_per_user_project.description: Maximum number of job cancellations allowed per minute for a given project.

job_erase_limit_per_user_project.description: Maximum number of job erasures allowed per minute for a given project.

job_play_limit_per_user_project.description: Maximum number of manual job runs allowed per minute for a given project.

job_retry_limit_per_user_project.description: Maximum number of job retries allowed per minute for a given project.

keep_latest_artifact.description: If `true`, prevents the deletion of the artifacts from the most recent successful jobs, regardless of the expiry time. Defaults to `true`.

kroki_diagram_proxy_enabled.description: Enable Kroki diagram proxy. Default is `false`.

kroki_formats.description: Additional formats supported by the Kroki instance. Possible values are `true` or `false` for formats `bpmn`, `blockdiag`, `excalidraw`, and `mermaid` in the format `<format>: true` or `<format>: false`.

local_markdown_version.description: Local Markdown version. Increase this value to invalidate all cached Markdown.

lock_built_in_project_templates_enabled.description: If `true`, enforces the `built_in_project_templates_enabled` setting for all groups. Premium and Ultimate only. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/235284) in GitLab 19.0 [with a feature flag](https://docs.gitlab.com/administration/feature_flags/) named `use_built_in_project_templates_enabled`. [Generally available](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/work_items/593623) in GitLab 19.2. Feature flag `use_built_in_project_templates_enabled` removed.

lock_duo_custom_agents_enabled.description: If `true`, enforces the custom agents enabled setting for all groups. GitLab Self-Managed, Premium and Ultimate only. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/work_items/594615) in GitLab 19.0.

lock_duo_custom_flows_enabled.description: If `true`, enforces the custom flows enabled setting for all groups. GitLab Self-Managed, Premium and Ultimate only. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/work_items/594615) in GitLab 19.0.

lock_duo_external_agents_enabled.description: If `true`, enforces the external agents enabled setting for all groups. GitLab Self-Managed, Premium and Ultimate only. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/work_items/594615) in GitLab 19.0.

lock_duo_features_enabled.description: If `true`, enforces the GitLab Duo features enabled setting for all subgroups. GitLab Self-Managed, Premium and Ultimate only.

lock_duo_remote_flows_enabled.description: If `true`, enforces the GitLab Duo remote flows enabled setting for all subgroups.

lock_duo_scheduled_automations_enabled.description: If `true`, enforces the scheduled automations enabled setting for all groups.

lock_memberships_to_saml.description: If `true`, enforces a [global lock on SAML group memberships](https://docs.gitlab.com/user/group/saml_sso/group_sync/#global-saml-group-memberships-lock).

lock_require_sha_for_merge.description: If `true`, enforces the `require_sha_for_merge` setting for all groups on the instance. [Introduced](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/236732) in GitLab 19.2.

logging_field_dual_emit_target.description: Version to dual-emit alongside schema_version. Must be strictly greater than schema_version, or omit/null to disable.

logging_field_schema_version.description: Logging field schema version (v0, v1, …). Cannot be downgraded.

mailgun_signing_key.description: Mailgun HTTP webhook signing key for receiving events from webhook.

maintenance_mode.description: If `true`, puts the instance into maintenance mode. Non-administrator users can sign in with read-only access and make read-only API requests. Premium and Ultimate only.

maintenance_mode_message.description: Message displayed when instance is in maintenance mode. Premium and Ultimate only.

make_profile_private.description: If `true`, allows users to make their profiles private.
